lines.text: The team sailed from Troas to Samothrace, then Neapolis, and went on to the Roman colony of Philippi.
Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth from Thyatira, was baptized with her household and urged the team to stay.
Paul commanded the spirit in the name of King David to leave the girl, and her owners seized him.
Paul and Silas were beaten and jailed in the inner cell, and about midnight they prayed, then an earthquake struck.
Paul said they were Roman soldiers, and the alarmed magistrates appeased them, then Paul and Silas went to Lydia's house.
